# Hatch

> Editorial React design system for personal products. Dashed frames, hatch rules, handwritten notes, origin-ripple actions.

- Docs: https://ui.pritishbudhiraja.com
- Components: https://ui.pritishbudhiraja.com/components
- Foundations: https://ui.pritishbudhiraja.com/foundations
- Agents: https://ui.pritishbudhiraja.com/agents
- Full catalog: https://ui.pritishbudhiraja.com/llms-full.txt
- GitHub: https://github.com/PritishBudhiraja/pb-ui
- npm: @pritish.budhiraja/ui , @pritish.budhiraja/tokens

## Install

pnpm add @pritish.budhiraja/ui
import "@pritish.budhiraja/ui/styles.css"

Set data-theme="portfolio" on the document. Toggle class="dark".
OriginButton and ScrollProgress: import from @pritish.budhiraja/ui/motion.
ThemeToggle is controlled (theme + setTheme). Host owns storage.

## Invariants

- No Next.js APIs in library components
- No Epoch domain widgets (SeasonCard, FocusTimer, TaskRow)
- Semantic tokens only — no hardcoded product hex
- Prefer composition over a new name for the same job
- Motion is an optional peer; core UI must not import framer-motion

## Signature

OriginButton, FramedContainer, HatchDivider, EditorialAnnotation, CalendarHeatmap, ThemeToggle, ScrollProgress, Surface

## Categories

- Actions: Button, IconButton, LinkButton, LoadingButton, CopyButton
- Forms: Input, Textarea, Label, Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup, Select, Combobox, Slider, FormField, SearchInput, DatePicker, TimePicker, FilterBar
- Overlays: Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Popover, Tooltip, DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, CommandPalette, Toast, Alert, EmptyState, ErrorState, Skeleton, Spinner, ProgressBar
- Navigation: Tabs, Accordion, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Navbar, Sidebar, AppShell, KeyboardShortcut
- Data: Text, Heading, Badge, Avatar, Card, Table, DataTable, Timeline, StatCard, DescriptionList, Stack, Grid, Separator
